newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsui Sec says will cut fees earlier than planned.
newsitem.headline: Matsui Sec says will cut fees earlier than planned.

text.p: Matsui Securities Co Ltd said on Monday that it would cut its brokerage fees on stocks and convertible bonds traded over the counter on February 17, earlier than it announced on Friday.
On Friday, Matsui Securities said it would cut its fees in half from March.
The small Japanese securities firm said in a statement that it moved up the fee cut because of strong demand from investors.
